# Vendored references (read by this skill only)

From [calesthio/generative-media-skills](https://github.com/calesthio/generative-media-skills), MIT
(see `LICENSE-generative-media-skills`). Copied 2026-10-30 as reference guides, renamed
`SKILL.md` → `GUIDE.md` so they never trigger on their own (social-short-production would
otherwise push captions and music onto this creator's edits).

| Guide | Use it for | Ignore in it |
|---|---|---|
| `vfx-compositing/GUIDE.md` | Job B integration: 2D / 2.5D / 3D matchmove choice, tracking checks, grain/sharpness/motion blur, contact shadows, the QA sequence | its AI-generation provider advice |
| `cinematic-shot-direction/GUIDE.md` | camera relationship, shot size/height/angle, parallax (dolly vs zoom), screen direction | AI-video prompting parts |
| `social-short-production/GUIDE.md` | retention-curve diagnosis, mute-viewing pass, phone-size QA | captions, music, hooks, re-cutting: the creator's rules win |
